description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for Git's diff functionality, particularly focusing on the behavior of the -B (break) and -M (rename) options. It sets up different scenarios involving file modifications, renames, copies, and type changes, and verifies the output of 'git diff-index' against expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, setting up, executing, and verifying a specific scenario.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares the actual git diff output with the expected output to verify correctness.
